purpose: The three page design styles a client chooses from at intake. design_styles.md (references/design-styles.md) is the full definition; this file is the data the code and the intake question read.
library: BlackCEO LLC GoHighLevel media library, folder sigpage-reference-images

styles.name: Block
styles.one_line: Clean rectangular photos and straight-edged sections, like a magazine layout. Classic, polished and easy to read.

example.label: Block example (desktop page)
example.note: Structure and image shape only. The example's colors, brand and words are never used.

prompt_rules.all: STYLE A BLOCK: traditional editorial layout. Every photo is a rectangle with square corners; no circular crops, no rings, no rounded photo corners. Full-width alternating bands, a text column and a photo column that swap sides, rectangular buttons, hairline rules.
prompt_rules.wireframe: Draw every image slot as a rectangle labeled with its ratio.
prompt_rules.mockup: Render every photo as a square-cornered rectangle.

styles.name: Circle
styles.one_line: Round framed photos with colored rings, circular text panels and soft curved shapes. Warm, friendly and a little more playful.

example.label: Circle example (desktop page)
example.note: Structure and image shape only. The example's colors, brand and words are never used.

prompt_rules.all: STYLE B CIRCLE: round-photo layout. Feature, benefit and people rows pair one large photo circle with one circular text panel that overlaps it, alternating sides down the page; each photo circle has a partial ring (crescent) offset to its outer-bottom edge in a brand accent color. Pill-shaped buttons, rounded panels, soft curved dividers. Hero, proof and offer panels may stay rectangular.
prompt_rules.wireframe: Draw each circle slot as a circle, with its circular text panel overlapping it and the slot label beside it.
prompt_rules.mockup: Render each circle slot as a round photo with its ring in the brand accent; the corners outside the circle are the page background.

styles.name: Hybrid
styles.one_line: The straight, polished structure of Block with round photos and ring accents on the personal pictures, such as you, your team and your clients.

example.note: No Style C example exists yet. Generate a real Hybrid page, upload it with the same method, and replace this entry.

prompt_rules.all: STYLE C HYBRID: Block structure (full-width alternating bands, text column and photo column, rectangular hero, proof and offer panels) with circle accents only on the slots marked circle below; every other photo stays a square-cornered rectangle. One ring treatment on all circle slots, in a brand accent color.
prompt_rules.wireframe: Draw circle slots as circles and every other slot as a rectangle.
prompt_rules.mockup: Render circle slots as round photos with the ring in the brand accent and every other photo as a rectangle.

circle_clause: CIRCLE CROP SAFE FRAME: compose a perfectly square 1:1 image for a round crop. Place the subject centered in the frame with the face or main object inside the central 60 percent. Keep every important element inside the inscribed circle; the four corners are cropped away, so leave them as quiet, out-of-focus background with no text, no hands, no props and no object edges touching the corners.

question.intro: Which look do you want for your page? There are three styles. Tap each link to see a real example of the shape and layout. Your own colors, logo and words go on whichever one you pick; the examples only show the design.
question.closing: Tell me A, B or C. If you are not sure, tell me three words for how you want your brand to feel and I will recommend one.
question.unsure_rule: Recommend one style with a one-sentence reason from the brand's feel; record it with design_style_source recommended_accepted only after the client agrees.
